# RAD deer: All RAD deer spawn locations including map

![RAD deer: All RAD deer spawn locations including map](/uploads/383_blog-teaser-template.jpg)

![skywalka](/public/avatar_skywalka_fo76_nuka_knights_variant2_square_white-black.png) 

RAD deer are consistently found in several locations in Appalachia. There are challenges where you have to find RAD deer. All types of RAD deer count, including albino RAD deer.

## Places with RAD deer

- Wixon Homestead (west)
- Whitespring Golf Club
- Safe N Clean Disposal
- East of Dent & Sons Construction
-The Freak Show
- Southwest of Seneca Rocks Visitor Center
- South of Monongah Lookout
- Southeast of Hopewell Cave
- Between the Refuge and Haven Church
- Southeast of Big Fred's BBQ Shack
- Between The Thorn and Appalachian Antiques
-Old Crimora Mines
- Southeast of Naked Creek
- South of Camp Rapidan
- Between Slumber Mill Motel and South River Bridge
- East of Camp Liberty
